name: TaxTriage
developers: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory
intended_taxa: Untargeted microbial/pathogen discovery across clinical animal and environmental samples
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria archaea viruses fungi; broader taxa depend on database
identification_strategy: Kraken2 or Centrifuge nominates candidates; BWA-MEM2/minimap2 alignment; coverage conflict analysis and TASS confidence scoring
report_summary: Interactive HTML Organism Discovery Report; per-sample PDF; MultiQC
notes: Pathogen-focused interpretation sheet limits rich contextual reporting; local databases supported

name: nf-core/taxprofiler
intended_taxa: General shotgun taxonomic profiling
capable_taxa_summary: Database and selected classifier dependent across microbial and other taxa
identification_strategy: Parallel classification/profiling with Kraken2 Bracken Centrifuge Kaiju MALT DIAMOND MetaPhlAn mOTUs KMCP and others
report_summary: MultiQC HTML; Krona plots
notes: No standard database is provided or built by default

name: CZ ID local short-read MNGS workflow
developers: Chan Zuckerberg Initiative and Chan Zuckerberg Biohub
status: Active local workflow; hosted portal account required
intended_taxa: Hypothesis-free pathogen detection in host-associated and environmental samples
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria archaea viruses fungi and microbial eukaryotes; broader hits depend on NT/NR content
identification_strategy: Host subtraction; NT nucleotide and NR protein alignment; SPAdes contig assembly and alignment; NCBI taxonomic aggregation
report_summary: Hosted portal has interactive taxon reports; local workflow primarily files and tables
notes: Only the local workflow with unauthenticated public reference downloads is counted

name: EDGE Bioinformatics
developers: Los Alamos National Laboratory and collaborators
status: Public v2.x development; deployment docs target older Linux
intended_taxa: Broad microbial genomics and metagenomic pathogen detection
capable_taxa_summary: Microbes across bacteria archaea viruses fungi and protists; broader taxa are database dependent
identification_strategy: Integrated QC and host filtering with classifier alignment assembly and organism analysis modules
report_summary: Built-in interactive HTML reports
notes: Modular platform rather than one fixed taxonomic algorithm

name: bioBakery workflows wmgx
intended_taxa: Microbial community profiling from whole-metagenome shotgun reads
capable_taxa_summary: Primarily bacteria archaea fungi/microbial eukaryotes; viral support depends on MetaPhlAn version and database
identification_strategy: KneadData host/QC filtering; MetaPhlAn marker-gene profiles; HUMAnN functions; optional StrainPhlAn
report_summary: Separate Pweave visualization workflow produces PDF or HTML
notes: Report is generated by a separate visualization workflow

name: SqueezeMeta
status: Active; current stable and development versions
intended_taxa: Environmental microbial metagenomes and metatranscriptomes
capable_taxa_summary: Microbes primarily; eukaryotic hits optional and database dependent
identification_strategy: Assembly and ORF prediction; DIAMOND/BLAST taxonomy aggregated from genes to contigs bins and taxa; optional read annotation
report_summary: No standard HTML/PDF run report; SQMtools and Watermelon are downstream
notes: Also has direct read-assignment scripts; not just MAG profiling

name: HOME-BIO
intended_taxa: Clinical shotgun analysis of biological entities
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria viruses protozoa and selected fungi according to supplied Kraken2/Kaiju indexes
identification_strategy: Combines Kraken2 k-mer and Kaiju translated-protein classification; optional SPAdes and Bowtie2
report_summary: Tables PNG plots and logs; no consolidated HTML/PDF
notes: Paper describes GPL while current repository states LGPL-3.0

name: MOCAT2
intended_taxa: Microbial community profiling
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria and archaea via mOTU and RefMG/NCBI mapping references
identification_strategy: Maps reads to mOTU marker genes or RefMG reference genes then aggregates taxon abundance
report_summary: Tabular taxon and abundance profiles; no HTML/PDF
notes: Shipped databases are legacy snapshots

name: RIEMS
developers: FLI collaborators; repository hosted by EBI-COMMUNITY
status: Abandoned legacy; GI-indexed database and old dependencies
intended_taxa: Untargeted sequence sorting against local NCBI nucleotide and protein databases
capable_taxa_summary: Database dependent across all represented domains
identification_strategy: BLAST/MegaBLAST searches reads and contigs; tax IDs attached and summarized; optional ViRIEMS viral pass
report_summary: Optional R/knitr/LaTeX PDF result protocol
notes: Current NCBI compatibility is doubtful

name: MetaShot
developers: University of Bari and Italian National Research Council groups
intended_taxa: Human microbiota; supports environmental use
capable_taxa_summary: Prokaryotes viruses fungi and protists; not intended for plants or animals
identification_strategy: FaQCs QC; STAR/Bowtie2 host/read filtering; TANGO taxonomic classification; domain-specific references
report_summary: Krona HTML taxonomy visualization
notes: Local identification does not require optional online visualization

name: nf-core/mag
intended_taxa: Genome-resolved microbial metagenomics
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria and archaea primary; optional viral/eukaryotic classification; read classifier breadth follows DB
identification_strategy: Kraken2/Centrifuge reads; assembly; binning; GTDB-Tk/CAT; optional geNomad and Tiara
report_summary: MultiQC HTML and bin reports
notes: Read classification and genome-resolved calls are distinct result types

name: ATLAS
intended_taxa: Environmental microbial metagenomes from reads to bins
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria and archaea primary; optional virus/eukaryote extensions
identification_strategy: Snakemake QC assembly gene prediction read mapping binning and taxonomy of recovered genomes
report_summary: No standard report; analysis/visualization extensions are separate
notes: Organisms that do not assemble/bin are not in MAG profiles

name: MGnify pipeline v5
intended_taxa: Microbial raw-read WGS taxonomy and functional profiling
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria archaea and microbial eukaryotes via rRNA/mOTUs; not clinical pathogen triage
identification_strategy: CWL QC; SSU/LSU/Rfam marker taxonomy; mOTUs; HMM/InterProScan/EggNOG/DIAMOND functions
report_summary: No local standalone HTML/PDF; hosted MGnify portal is separate
notes: Repository archived 16 June 2026

name: MetaWRAP
status: No longer actively supported by original authors
intended_taxa: Microbial communities with emphasis on genome recovery
capable_taxa_summary: Any taxa represented in selected Kraken/Kraken2 database; microbial MAG workflow
identification_strategy: Optional Kraken/Kraken2 read/contig profiling; MEGAHIT/metaSPAdes; MetaBAT/MaxBin/CONCOCT and bin refinement
report_summary: Classification tables and plots; no integrated HTML/PDF organism report
notes: Main workflow focuses on MAG recovery

name: IMP
developers: Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine R3lab
intended_taxa: Integrated microbial metagenomics and metatranscriptomics; metagenome-only mode available
capable_taxa_summary: Microbial communities; reference/database dependent
identification_strategy: Snakemake QC assembly gene prediction mapping and homology/reference annotation
report_summary: No consistent standalone report verified
notes: Assembly-centric calls can miss low-abundance unassembled taxa

name: Metagenomics-Toolkit
intended_taxa: Data-agnostic microbial short- and long-read metagenomes
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria and archaea primary; optional viral/eukaryotic modules are limited
identification_strategy: Nextflow QC assembly with ML-enabled memory allocation read mapping binning and genome taxonomy
report_summary: No uniform HTML/PDF report verified
notes: Genome-resolved identification rather than universal raw-read profiling

name: KAPTAIN
intended_taxa: Untargeted Oxford Nanopore shotgun microbial classification
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria archaea fungi and protozoa; viral and plasmid hits deliberately removed
identification_strategy: KMA mapping; removes plasmid hits; recalculates metrics against genomes; selects best template identity and applies target-FDR threshold
report_summary: HTML report; optional Galaxy requires registration
notes: Authors recommend 500M post-filtered bases minimum and ideally 1000M

name: ViroProfiler
intended_taxa: Untargeted viral metagenomes
capable_taxa_summary: Viruses
identification_strategy: QC/background subtraction assembly viral sequence detection taxonomy and abundance characterization
report_summary: Summary-report tool not clearly stated
notes: Viral domain only

name: VirMake
intended_taxa: Untargeted paired-end viral metagenomics
capable_taxa_summary: Viruses
identification_strategy: metaSPAdes/metaQUAST; VirSorter2/geNomad; CheckV; Galah; Prodigal; vConTACT2; DRAM-v
report_summary: metaQUAST HTML assembly-QC; no integrated taxonomy report verified
notes: Offline and HPC execution supported

name: nf-core/viralmetagenome
intended_taxa: Untargeted viral metagenomic reconstruction
capable_taxa_summary: Viruses
identification_strategy: QC host removal optional read classification assembly viral contig identification and mapping/variant analysis
report_summary: MultiQC HTML for process/QC
notes: Primarily viral genome reconstruction rather than abundance profiling

name: metavirs
intended_taxa: Illumina environmental viral shotgun metagenomes
capable_taxa_summary: Viruses
identification_strategy: Snakemake/Singularity QC assembly and database-supported viral contig annotation/classification
report_summary: No dedicated HTML/PDF sample report confirmed
citation: Kuhn and Schaughency metavirs software release; 2022
notes: Virus-only; assembly-first

name: SURPI
developers: Chiu Lab University of California San Francisco and collaborators
intended_taxa: Untargeted clinical pathogen discovery
capable_taxa_summary: Bacteria and viruses; broad comprehensive nucleotide/protein mode can also return fungi/parasites and other represented taxa
identification_strategy: SNAP nucleotide alignment; RAPSearch2 protein search; optional Minimo/ABySS assembly and local taxonomy lookup
report_summary: Tabular organism results and coverage plots; no standalone HTML/PDF confirmed
notes: Historical GI-based databases; optional Twitter API not required for identification
